articleSummary: HEV infections in Shanghai were analyzed across 4,668 confirmed cases from 2017–2022, drawn from China’s National Notifiable Disease Reporting System, for an average annual rate of 3.14 per 100,000. A six-year temporal-spatial analysis identified a significant time cluster Jan 1, 2017–May 31, 2019 (RR 1.35; LLR 52.18) and a winter-to-spring seasonal peak (December–May). Spatially, one primary cluster (RR 1.73; LLR 135.74) emerged, centered in central urban districts with secondary clusters in peri-urban suburbs; raw case counts were highest in dense areas, but the cluster remained strongest when adjusted for population. Logistic regression linked higher density (OR 7.367), more shopping malls (OR 1.531), and shorter distance to rivers (OR 0.742) with clustering. Mechanisms remain unresolved.

articleHeadline: New Antibody Tests Outperform PCR in Detecting Devastating Rice Panicle
articleSummary: Dot-ELISA and CGICS, developed by Zhejiang University researchers, detect Burkholderia glumae and B. plantarii, the primary agents of rice bacterial panicle blight (RBPB). articleSummary: Flooding from the Iguaçu River in União da Vitória raises leptospirosis risk. Early symptoms mimic flu: fever, headache, muscle pains (calves), chills, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting; diarrhea, joint pains, eye changes, cough may occur. Diagnosis via clinical evaluation and lab tests; treated with antibiotics; do not self-medicate. Reinforce post-flood hygiene and rodent control.

articleSummary: New Delhi, India-based study analyzes whole-blood transcriptomes from 112 dengue-positive patients at their first hospital visit (mean fever 3.7 days). articleHeadline: Fat Thieves: How Leishmania infantum Rewires Host Cell Lipids to Fuel
articleSummary: Leishmania infantum drives visceral leishmaniasis, a fatal infection of the spleen, liver and bone marrow if untreated, transmitted by sandflies. In a Parasites & Vectors study led by Cínthia Siess-Portugal and Hiro Goto at the Universidade de São Paulo with collaborators in Peru, researchers used untargeted lipidomics on infected human THP-1 macrophages to map lipid remodeling as amastigotes proliferate inside phagolysosomes. They found substantial transfer of host lipids to the parasite, with exogenous fatty acids remodeled into polyunsaturated species, indicating parasite synthesis rather than mere scavenging. Infected macrophages show depletion of mitochondrial lipids, including cardiolipin, and loss of glycosphingolipids, potentially impairing energy production and immune signaling. A biphasic response emerges: early lipid supply supports amastigote biomass; later lipids accumulate as storage for post-proliferation survival. Distinct parasite sterols (ergosterol) mark parasite-specific lipid remodeling.

articleSummary: Three cases of a rapidly spreading influenza A (H3N2) subclade K, described as 'super flu,' are confirmed in North Sumatra, Indonesia, per the Ministry of Health’s Influenza and COVID-19 Case Surveillance Report through 19 September 2026 (week 37). Jawa Timur (East Java) and Kalimantan Selatan (South Kalimantan) report a higher total of 18 cases, indicating broader circulation. Health authorities emphasize that 'super flu' is not an official medical term; it denotes ISPA caused by influenza A H3N2 with mutations that may erode protection from standard vaccines and accelerate transmission. Symptoms include severe cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, muscle aches, headache, and extreme fatigue appearing 3–4 days after exposure, often mistaken for COVID-19. Contextual history cites mid-2025 activity in the UK, Japan, and the US, with New York reaching about 71,000 weekly cases at a mutation-driven peak.
notes: 記事は北スマトラ、東ジャワ、南カリマンタンなどインドネシア国内の複数州での症例増加を報告。英国・日本・米国の言及は2025年中頃の過去の流行に関する背景情報であり、現行イベントの発生地とは異なるため対象国リストには含めない。「スーパーフル」は非公式な通称であり、H3N2サブクレードKによる免疫逃避変異が懸念されている。重症度や死亡例に関する具体的情報はなく、続報の確認が必要。

articleHeadline: Gut Microbe's Acetate Signal Calms Deadly Diarrhea in Newborn Calves
articleSummary: Published in Microbiome on 2026-09-26, Huazhong Agricultural University researchers trace a microbiota–metabolite–immune axis in neonatal calf diarrhea. Diarrheic newborn calves show gut dysbiosis, metabolic perturbation, and inflammatory activation. Fecal microbiota transplantation from healthy calves alleviates diarrhea and coincides with enrichment of Bifidobacterium pseudocatenulatum and higher fecal acetate. In vitro, live B. pseudocatenulatum increases acetate production, suggesting a causal bacterium–metabolite link. In murine models mimicking calf intestinal injury, treatment with live B. pseudocatenulatum or acetate reduces intestinal damage and pathogen-driven Th17/IL-17A responses; heat-killed bacteria lose protection, implicating microbial metabolism. Acetate signals via FFAR2, and FFAR2 blockade attenuates protection. These findings define a targetable microbiota–metabolite–immune pathway with potential probiotic or metabolite-based interventions for neonatal calf diarrhea.

articleHeadline: AI could expand affordable tuberculosis screening in rural Philippines
articleSummary: AI-assisted chest X-ray interpretation could lower TB screening costs in rural Philippines. The 2024 Philippine TB burden reached about 739,000 cases, representing 6.8% of the world’s 10.8 million TB cases. Ateneo de Manila University researchers modeled 1,000 presumptive TB patients undergoing chest radiography over five years, including AI software costs, radiologist fees, and confirmatory GeneXpert testing. The AI strategy shows an estimated annual cost of Php 877,330 versus Php 1.14 million for manual interpretation, equating to roughly Php 877 per person with AI and Php 1,142 per person manually. Beyond efficiency, AI could extend expert-level support to underserved rural communities using portable digital X-rays with limited connectivity, aiming to narrow geographic disparities. AI remains effective but not always cost-saving if radiologist fees are low or Philippine-specific performance estimates apply. The study recommends pilot implementation in underserved rural health units with local validation, QA, monitoring, and budget assessment, with continued confirmatory testing.

articleHeadlineTranslated: New Chinese Virus? The Truth About ALTNV and the Symptoms of Infection.
articleHeadline: Новый китайский вирус? Правда об ALTNV и симптомы инфекции
articleSummary: ALTNV is not a new pathogen; it is a tick-borne virus in the Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever group, identified through advanced genetic analysis in China. In Russia, there are no officially reported human cases; transmission occurs only via tick bites, specifically the Asian long-horned tick, found in the Far East (Primorsky Krai and southern Khabarovsk Krai), with European Russia unlikely to host this vector. Symptoms resemble other acute tick-borne infections: abrupt fever, chills, severe headache, myalgia, sometimes nausea or diarrhea; labs show thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, and elevated liver enzymes, with potential bleeding or petechiae in severe thrombocytopenia. The 18% mortality figure is overstated and applies only to patients with co-infections; isolated ALTNV infections are typically moderate with no deaths. No vaccine or specific therapy exists; prevention relies on repellents, light-colored closed clothing, and thorough body checks after outdoor activity. In Kuban (Krasnodar region), 2026 tick bites total 3,574 (1,365 children), down 10.5% vs 2025; Krasnodar city accounts for 683 cases (231 children); last week, 21 cases. Surveillance of ~11,000 ticks found 17.2% positive for Lyme borreliosis among 2,802 tested.
notes: 見出しは『新型中国ウイルス』への懸念を喚起する体裁だが、記事内容はALTNV（CCHF近縁のマダニ媒介ウイルス）が既知の病原体であり、ロシアでは人での確認症例がないこと、致死率18%という数字が誇張であることを説明する啓発記事。対象国リストに含まれるRussiaは無く、Chinaは『遺伝子解析で同定された場所』としての言及のみで実際の発生事例ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

articleHeadline: ASP in Spanien: Wie stark trifft die Seuche den Schweinefleisch-Export?
articleSummary: Spain’s African swine fever (ASF) outbreak near Barcelona persists. As of 24 Sep 2026, 379 ASF cases have been reported; around 396 animals tested positive near Barcelona, with 354 wild boars captured in the last week. Since the outbreak, roughly 12,300 wild boars have been hunted. Containment relies on ~350 barriers, 130+ traps, and enforcement by about 1,100 personnel, 351 hunters and 400 dogs. Economic impact: live pig imports plunged ~45% in volume to 2.05 million animals; value down ~47% to €157 million. Jan–Jun 2026 pork exports totaled over 1.35 million tonnes worth ~€3.6 billion. China remained the top destination by volume (16.2%) but cut orders 22% in volume and 35% in value; by value, France led (€464m), with China at ~€380m. Catalonia accounted for 49% of volume/value, Aragon 29%/24%. After winter 2025/26 restrictions (~35% exports blocked), H1 2026 shows relief; authorities aim to finish eradication this year.
